description: Source code for transformers and Babel integration in a challenge builder, including functions for transpiling JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, and handling HTML/CSS/JS embedding.

classes.name: WorkerExecutor
classes.description: Class for executing worker tasks, used for SASS compilation.

methods.name: loadBabel
methods.description: Dynamically imports Babel standalone library and registers loop protection plugins.

methods.name: babelTransformCode
methods.description: Returns a function that transforms code using Babel with specified options.

methods.name: getJSTranspiler
methods.description: Creates a transpiler function for JavaScript files with loop protection.

methods.name: getJSXTranspiler
methods.description: Creates a transpiler function for JSX files with loop protection.

methods.name: getJSXModuleTranspiler
methods.description: Creates a module transpiler for JSX files with loop protection.

methods.name: getTSTranspiler
methods.description: Creates a transpiler for TypeScript files with loop protection.

methods.name: getTSXModuleTranspiler
methods.description: Creates a module transpiler for TSX files with loop protection.

methods.name: createTranspiler
methods.description: Returns a combined transpiler based on file type.

methods.name: createModuleTransformer
methods.description: Returns a module transformer based on file type.

methods.name: getBabelOptions
methods.description: Generates Babel options with loop protection plugins based on parameters.

methods.name: transformSASS
methods.description: Transforms SASS/SCSS styles in a document element using a worker executor.

methods.name: transformScript
methods.description: Transforms inline scripts in a document element, optionally using modules.

methods.name: embedFilesInHtml
methods.description: Embeds HTML, CSS, and JS files into a content document, transforming as needed.

methods.name: challengeFilesToObject
methods.description: Converts challenge files array into an object with specific keys.

methods.name: parseAndTransform
methods.description: Parses HTML string into DOM and applies a transformation function.

methods.name: getHtmlTranspiler
methods.description: Creates an HTML transpiler that processes styles and scripts.
